name: coding-style
description: Cross-domain code + environment conventions, independent of any app stack: lint-format (language-agnostic tooling floor), brevity (a line must inform or go — comments, commits, PRs; plus which anti-verbosity rules are model-version debt), ts-style (TS/JS house style), svelte (Svelte + SvelteKit style), and fish (Eetu's default shell — POSIX gotchas). Future: python-style, git-conventions, etc.
